name: glide-pill-tabs
title: Glide Pill Tabs
author: henriquegpb <https://github.com/henriquegpb>
description: A pill of filter tabs where the selection slides from option to option and a softer hover highlight glides behind them; when the options overflow, the row scrolls sideways to keep the chosen one in view.
docs: Live preview and the CSS, JavaScript and Tailwind variants: https://microkit.co/components/glide-pill-tabs
